Japan's premier gathering for the Python community.
Welcome to PyCon JP 2026, held in Hiroshima.
We welcome everyone who uses Python, wants to start learning it, or is involved in the community. Through talk sessions, sprints, and various events, we look forward to seeing you again and to new encounters.

Keynote.
World-class Pythonistas take the stage
Keynote Speakers
PyCon JP 2026 is pleased to welcome Carol Willing and Takashi Kitao as keynote speakers.
Carol has long been a leader in the Python and open science communities, while Kitao has expanded the creative and playful possibilities of Python. Both speakers share a passion for education, and their keynotes will invite us to reflect on the past, present, and future of Python through their unique perspectives spanning open source, creativity, and community.
Details
Invited Talk.
Featured guests we're honored to host
We are excited to present a special collaborative talk by PyLadies Seoul and PyLadies Tokyo.
PyLadies members from two different regions will share stories about their respective communities.
More details will be published on the Invited Talks page at a later date.
Stay tuned!
